t: The Best Couches Of 2025: Our Top Picks After Over A Year Of Testing
s: December 18, 2025 - If you prefer a warm-to-the-touch sofa, you might want to steer clear of leather, which can remain chilly, especially in colder months; for those who want something soft, stick with velvet, cotton blends, suede or microfiber. And don’t forget about the fill: For a super-fluffy cushion, look for a large percentage of down fill, but if you prefer a firmer seat, go for a foam or spring core wrapped in fiber. As with most furniture items, you get what you pay for when buying a couch.
